config.handyshulker.title: Handy Shulker Settings
config.handyshulker.enableClickInsert.de: Right-click a shulker box on an item to insert it into the shulker.
Scroll over a shulker box to select and extract items from it.
config.handyshulker.enableEnderChestSupp: Apply click-to-insert, scroll-to-extract and tooltip previews to ender chests too. Contents sync from the server.
config.handyshulker.showFullnessBar.desc: Show a progress bar indicating how full the shulker box is.
config.handyshulker.showColoredBorders.d: Tint tooltip borders to match the shulker box color.
config.handyshulker.enableSounds.desc: Play sounds when inserting or extracting items from shulker boxes.
config.handyshulker.soundVolume.desc: Volume multiplier for all Handy Shulker sounds.
config.handyshulker.defaultCompactMode.d: Show compact tooltip by default. Hold the modifier key to toggle to grid mode.
config.handyshulker.compactModeKey.desc: Modifier key that toggles between grid and compact tooltip. Set to None to disable toggling.
config.handyshulker.showAllSlots.desc: Always render the full 3×9 tooltip grid, including empty slots.
config.handyshulker.showItemName.desc: Display the selected item name above the tooltip.
config.handyshulker.showItemCounts.desc: Show aggregated item count badges in compact mode.
config.handyshulker.tooltipSize.desc: Size of the shulker box tooltip grid. Smaller sizes take up less screen space.
